text: A food-delivery platform is evaluating staffing requirements for a restaurant's evening delivery slot. The number of orders received during nine randomly selected evening shifts is: 42, 48, 51, 55, 55, 58, 61, 64, 126. The restaurant manager proposes using the arithmetic mean as the standard number of orders for rostering delivery partners. A regional operations analyst argues that this may lead to systematic overstaffing on normal evenings. (a) Calculate the mean, median, and mode of the number of orders.

A regional operations analyst argues that this may lead to systematic overstaffing on normal evenings. (b) Critically assess the two managers' positions. Identify the feature of the data that affects the choice of a central-tendency measure and recommend a staffing benchmark for a typical evening. State one operational risk of relying only on your recommended measure.

Two content creators are being considered for a fixed-fee campaign by a consumer brand. Their daily video views, in thousands, over five comparable posting days are: Creator A: 28, 30, 32, 34, 36. Creator B: 20, 25, 32, 39, 44. The brand's marketing manager argues that both creators should be treated as equally dependable because their average reach is the same. (a) Calculate the range and sample standard deviation of daily views for each creator.
note: Measures of dispersion for sample data (range, sample variance, sample standard deviation) are not in the QTM decks; the decks cover the IQR and the standard deviation of a random variable only. The paper's formula list gives s² = Σ(x - x̄)²/(n - 1).

text: Two content creators are being considered for a fixed-fee campaign by a consumer brand. Their daily video views, in thousands, over five comparable posting days are: Creator A: 28, 30, 32, 34, 36. Creator B: 20, 25, 32, 39, 44. The brand's marketing manager argues that both creators should be treated as equally dependable because their average reach is the same. (b) Evaluate the manager's claim. If the campaign objective is to guarantee a reasonably predictable minimum daily reach, identify the most suitable creator and justify your recommendation using the calculated metrics. Briefly state why average reach alone is insufficient for this decision.
note: Needs dispersion (range and sample standard deviation), which is not in the QTM decks. The slides do say central tendency alone is not always enough.

text: LM Thapar School of Management is considering a policy on the academic use of generative AI tools. Before framing the policy, they plan to conduct a study to examine whether the use of AI tools is associated with QTM performance and students' confidence in learning. Dr Noor proposes collecting the following information: weekly hours spent using generative-AI tools for study purposes; programme or MBA section; QTM examination score; learning confidence, rated from 1 (very low) to 5 (very high); attendance at optional doubt-clearing sessions (Yes/No); student ID number. (a) Classify the above variables as qualitative or quantitative and identify the most appropriate measurement type: nominal, ordinal, discrete, or continuous. Also, identify one variable that should be used only as an identifier, not as an analytical measure.

text: An online learning platform classifies students as regular users or occasional users. Historical data show that 60% of students are regular users and 40% are occasional users. Among regular users, 80% complete an assigned QTM practice test, while 50% of occasional users do so. Let C denote the completion of the practice test. (a) Calculate the overall probability that a randomly selected student completes the practice test.

A large online grocery platform records the time taken to deliver customer orders. Historical data indicate that delivery time is approximately normally distributed with a mean of 4.2 days and a standard deviation of 1 day. The platform wants to evaluate its delivery performance. (a) What proportion of orders are delivered between 3 and 5.5 days? Use the standard normal table.
note: A standard normal table is provided with the paper.
